pages.title: Welcome
pages.content:
What is VerseBattles: Demon Chase?

VerseBattles: Demon Chase is an action game where you fight spiritual enemies by learning Bible verses. Demons chase you through dungeon rooms.

Your weapon? The Word of God. Answer verse quizzes correctly to power up your attacks and defeat the demons.

Pro Tip: Learn the Verses First!

The secret to winning is knowing your verses. Use the golden "Learn Verses Here!" button to study and meditate on the verses before battle. The more you know God's Word, the more powerful you become!

pages.title: Goal & Movement
pages.content:
Goal

Defeat enough monsters in each level to advance. There are 5 levels, each harder than the last. Choose from 5 map styles: Classic Dungeon, Narrow Paths, Complex Labyrinth, Open Plains, and Grid City.

Moving

Tap or click anywhere in the game area to move your character there. Your character walks toward the target automatically.

You move through dungeon rooms connected by corridors. Walls block your path — find the openings!

pages.title: Combat
pages.content:
Melee Combat

When you get close to a demon, combat starts automatically. You and the demon exchange blows every 0.7 seconds.

  • You only deal damage if your last quiz answer was correct
  • The demon always hits back (unless you have a shield)
  • Each demon type has different max damage

Shooting

Tap on a demon to fire a projectile at it. Each shot costs 1 Ammo. Earn more ammo by answering quizzes correctly (+5 per correct answer).

pages.title: Bible Verse Quizzes
pages.content:
How Quizzes Work

A Bible verse is always shown at the bottom of the screen with some words blanked out. Tap the button showing the correct first letters of the missing words.

Why It Matters

  • Correct answer: Your melee attacks deal damage, and you earn +5 Ammo
  • Wrong answer: Your attacks do nothing until you get the next one right

Verse Categories

Verses are grouped by categories like Faith, Courage, and Love. Tap the category name at the top of the screen to open the category picker and choose which verses you want to study.

pages.title: Items - Part 1
pages.content:
Healing Points

Green crosses appear in the dungeon. Walk over them to restore 25 health. Up to 2 exist at a time.

Shield of Faith

A golden diamond appears once per level. Walk over it to collect it into your inventory.

  • Tap the i button (top-left) to open your inventory
  • Tap Use to activate the shield
  • While active (10 seconds), you take zero damage from demons
  • A golden glow surrounds your character and a timer shows remaining time

pages.title: Items - Part 2
pages.content:
Armor of God

Collect pieces of the Armor of God as they appear in the dungeon:

  • Sword of the Spirit — increased melee damage
  • Belt of Truth — bonus protection
  • Helmet of Salvation — extra health
  • Breastplate of Righteousness — damage reduction
  • Sandals of Peace — movement speed boost

pages.title: Player Progression
pages.content:
Levelling Up

Killing demons earns 10 XP each. As you gain XP, your player level increases:

  • Higher level = more max health
  • Full health restore on level up

pages.title: Game Levels
pages.content:
There are 5 game levels. Beat 60% of the monsters to advance:

  • Level 1 (Stone Dungeon): Fear & Ignorance — slow, weak
  • Level 2 (Earth Dungeon): Strife, Confusion & Infirmity — faster, hit harder
  • Level 3 (Crystal Dungeon): Condemnation, Unbelief, Depression & Doubt — fast, dangerous
  • Level 4 (Shadow Dungeon): Pride, Spirit of Slumber & Jezebel — stronger with special abilities
  • Level 5 (Inferno Dungeon): All demon types — the ultimate challenge with scaling HP

Each level generates a new dungeon layout with a different colour theme.

pages.title: Tips
pages.content:
Top Tips

  • Learn your verses first! Tap the golden "Learn Verses Here!" button to study and meditate on verses — knowing them well is the key to winning consistently
  • Answer the quiz first before engaging a demon — otherwise your attacks do nothing
  • Use corridors to your advantage — demons can get stuck on walls
  • Save your Shield of Faith for tough fights with multiple chasers
  • Shoot from range to soften up enemies before going into melee
  • Watch your Ammo counter — keep answering quizzes to stay stocked

pages.title: Demon Abilities
pages.content:
Demon Types

  • Chasers — follow you relentlessly
  • Wanderers — walk randomly, but still hurt if you get close

Special Abilities (Later Levels)

  • Freezing Aura — slows your movement when nearby
  • Pride Armor — reduces damage taken until broken
  • Spirit Drain — steals your Ammo on hit
  • Strife Dash — charges at you with a burst of speed

Good luck, and may the Word be your sword!
